name: Half Baked Link Injection
author: emrysh

sections.description:
Half Baked Link Injection lets you define simple rules that automatically replace whole-word phrases with links when WordPress renders post and page content.

It is designed for clean, predictable linking that stays out of your way. Rules are applied only to the_content, and existing links are never modified. This makes it useful for SEO hygiene, internal linking, and turning recurring terms into consistent references without editing each post manually.

How it works

Create one or more injection rules. Each rule includes:
* A phrase (whole-word matching is always used)
* A destination URL (internal relative links or external URLs)
* Optional settings like case sensitivity, where it applies, and how often it triggers

When a post or page is displayed, the plugin scans only the text portions of the content and injects links where appropriate. It will not touch phrases inside existing <a> tags, and it skips script and style blocks to avoid breaking markup.

Targeting and control

Rules can be scoped and prioritized so you stay in control when phrases overlap or your site grows.
* Post type targeting: apply a rule to Posts, Pages, or both
* Priority ordering: lower numbers win when multiple rules could match the same spot
* Tie-breaking: if priorities match, newer rules win

Occurrence options

Control how frequently each phrase is linked:
* First
* First + every Nth (N from 1 to 10)
* Every Nth (N from 1 to 10)
* All

This is useful when you want a light touch on long articles.

External links done properly

When a rule points to an external URL, the plugin:
* Adds target="_blank"
* Ensures rel includes noopener noreferrer
* Lets you append additional rel tokens like nofollow or sponsored

Relative URLs stay relative and do not get target="_blank".

Built for safety and performance

  • No recursion into the_content
  • Processes content safely by splitting HTML and touching only text tokens
  • Hard limits on rules and field sizes to prevent runaway saves
  • Rules stored locally in a single WordPress option

Privacy & Data

This plugin does not send any data off-site. Link injection rules are stored locally in your WordPress database in a single option (hbli_rules).

Uninstall

Uninstalling the plugin removes the stored rules option from your database.

Features

  • Whole-word matching, with optional case sensitivity per rule
  • Skips existing links and will not inject inside <a> tags
  • Skips <script> and <style> content
  • Post type targeting (Posts, Pages)
  • Priority-based rule ordering with deterministic tie-breaking
  • Occurrence controls: First, First + every Nth, Every Nth, All
  • External link handling with safe rel tokens (noopener noreferrer always included)
  • Built-in internal link picker (search posts/pages and insert a relative URL)
  • Duplicate phrase protection (case-insensitive) to prevent unstable rule sets
  • Self-link prevention so a post/page will not link to itself
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Posts → Link Injection (or Pages → Link Injection) to add rules.
sections.faq:
Does it change existing links?

No. If a phrase appears inside an existing <a> tag, it is ignored and not replaced.

Does it work on excerpts, titles, or widgets?

No. Rules are applied to post/page content only via the_content.

What does whole-word matching mean?

The plugin uses whole-word boundaries, so it will not match partial words. For example, a rule for “cat” will not match “catch”.

How are conflicts handled when multiple rules could match?

Rules are evaluated by priority (lower wins). If priorities match, newer rules win. Existing links are never modified, and the plugin will not create nested links.

Can I add nofollow or sponsored to external links?

Yes. Add tokens in the rule’s Rel field. For external URLs, noopener noreferrer are always added.

Where are rules stored?

Rules are stored locally in your WordPress database in a single option named hbli_rules.

short_description: Inject links into post/page content based on user-defined rules. Operates on the_content only and skips inside existing links, scripts, and styles.
